messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — high p99 latency detected for customer \"Gala\" (enterprise, VPC/dedicated pool eu-west-2). p99=4.2s, SLO=500ms. Impacting ~18% of requests. Auto-runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/tenant-latency. Paging @lina-prod.

lina-prod: Ack. Joining war-room now. @meera-sre can you pull traces and the pool metrics?

meera-sre: I'm on it. Dashboards show a sharp tail starting 14:02 UTC across eu-west-2 dedicated pool. One tenant dominates: gala-enterprise-42. KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x. Logs: \"backpressure: queue_depth>500\" across several workers.

chris-engr: From routing side, we see long completions correlated with large-context prompts coming from that tenant. Any CS context @jacob-cs?

jacob-cs: Gala just replied — looks like an internal enrichment job started at ~14:00 and targeted prod endpoints. Their SRE says they're stopping it now.

meera-sre: Proposed mitigations: 1) Soft-isolate tenant to drain connections 2) Apply strict per-tenant emergency rate-limits 3) Route to smaller model variant (fallback) 4) If needed, scale pool or evict noisy workers. Starting 1 & 2 immediately.

lina-prod: Execute isolation (soft) and preserve caches where possible: `rbx isolate-tenant --tenant gala-enterprise-42 --mode soft --preserve-cache` — running.

satya-platform: Running isolation now — command returned success, connections draining (grace=10s). Applying ratelimit: 
```
rbx ratelimit set --tenant gala-enterprise-42 --qps 5 --burst 10
```
Rule applied. Observing p99 drop 4.2s -> 1.1s in ~45s but still above SLO.

meera-sre: Starting model fallback to redwood/ggml-medium-quant for that tenant (canary -> full) to reduce per-token latency.

chris-engr: Canary ok. Routed a subset at 14:06 UTC — tail latencies decreased. There's ~0.5% residual high latency, likely from client-side retry storms after initial failures. Adding retry suppression for that tenant.

lina-prod: Sent inbound message to Gala SRE: \"We isolated your tenant, applied emergency rate-limits and fallback. Please stop the batch job. We'll coordinate recovery plan.\" cc @jacob-cs

jacob-cs: Gala SRE confirmed they stopped the job at 14:08 UTC and asked for an ETA to restore normal throughput gracefully.

meera-sre: Recommend a staged unthrottle: keep QPS=3 for 30m, then 10 for 15m, then restore. Also require client-side backoff fixes. Creating incident ticket and RCA items.

lina-prod: Creating ticket INC-2026-5790012345 (owner: meera-sre). Attaching traces, flamegraphs, and command history. Handoff scheduled for 14:30 UTC.

simone-sre: I'll take the handoff at 14:30 and monitor for 2 hours. Please include the exact commands and S3 artifact links.

meera-sre: Snippets attached inline for the ticket: 
- isolation: `rbx isolate-tenant --tenant gala-enterprise-42 --mode soft`
- ratelimit: `rbx ratelimit set --tenant gala-enterprise-42 --qps 5`
- fallback routing: `rbx route set --tenant gala-enterprise-42 --model redwood/ggml-medium-quant --canary 10%`
Saved artifacts: s3://inference-incidents/5790012345/flame.tar.gz, s3://inference-incidents/5790012345/traces.json.gz

lina-prod: Customer impact summary so far: ~2.4k requests returned 503/429 during spike window. We'll coordinate CSM comms after RCA. @jacob-cs please prepare. :warning:

jacob-cs: Drafting message to Gala now, will include mitigations and next steps.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied (isolation, ratelimit, fallback). Severity downgraded Sev2 -> monitoring. p99 trending down, continue monitoring.

meera-sre: Closing active war-room. Handoff to simone-sre at 14:30 UTC for monitoring and follow-up. Postmortem to include: cause (runaway enrichment job + inadequate client retry/backoff), timeline, commands run, and recommendations (per-tenant throttles, better tenant-level circuit breakers, customer guidance).

simone-sre: Received handoff. Will watch for regressions, add runbook updates to ticket, and schedule RCA meeting with Gala. :thumbsup:

gala-sre-bot: Gala SRE confirms their batch was stopped and appreciates the rapid mitigation. Asking for a short call for recovery coordination.

lina-prod: Thanks everyone. Keep channel open until 15:00 UTC for any follow-ups, then archive.
